actions: Review p95 latency separately from probe health.
analysis: A release that sets DEMO_LATENCY_MS above zero injects business latency; readiness/liveness probes themselves are not delayed, so probes passing does not make the release safe.
cautions: Do not infer low latency from healthy probes.
excerpt: - 慢请求：`DEMO_LATENCY_MS=3000`，请求日志耗时约 3.00–3.01 秒；触发 DemoP95LatencyHigh，恢复后收到 resolved。
rollback: Restore DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 and verify the 5m p95 returns below the review threshold.
title: 3000ms 慢请求故障注入
